name: Women's CAP dark blue polo short sleeves, tactical polo: pen pocket on the left sleeve (overlay, registered to garment-polo-female)
size_basis: Pen pocket 1.4 x 5.5 in with a 1.35 in flap, centred on the visible face of the wearer's left sleeve (the picture's right) of garment-polo-female: its axis runs down the middle of the strip between the armhole seam and the outer edge, from the first row where that strip is 1.8 in wide and at least 1.5 in below the shoulder seam (here 1.82 in is the narrowest strip the pocket crosses). CAPR 39-1 5.3.1.3 gives only "pen pocket on left sleeve"; no dimension, and no photograph of a tactical polo on disk, so the pocket size and the flap are an ESTIMATE and nothing else is drawn: the tactical polo's embroidered seal on the right breast and the optional name and badge on the left breast are placed by the engine exactly as on the knit polo.
